why: Fresh read-only preflight saw both directories UID/GID 1000/1000 mode 0775, while staging v4 requires neither group nor other write; all eight existing control entries were UID1000. Current /data/source parent is UID1000 mode 0755 and has no POSIX ACL xattr.
remote_preconditions: Only non-root UID1000 on the pinned gz02 SSH host, current local_env project binding unchanged.

Open every parent and target as real directories through fd-relative O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW; exact project (dev 64785, ino 29884417, uid/gid 1000/1000) and control (dev 64785, ino 29884418, uid/gid 1000/1000).
Both target modes exactly 0775; every ancestor non-group/other-writable; no POSIX access/default ACL xattr on any opened chain component.
Fixed v4 stage lease and v7 final are both absent immediately before mutation. If either appears, reject without chmod.
Parent chain identity and modes stable immediately before fchmod.
mutation_and_readback: Exactly os.fchmod(control_fd, 0755), fsync(control_fd), os.fchmod(project_fd, 0755), fsync(project_fd). No mkdir, rename, unlink, chown, copy, source, output or configuration edit.
Reopen path chain with O_NOFOLLOW and compare pinned dev/inode/UID/GID and expected modes; inspect ACL and lease/final absence again. Return success only after both readbacks.
Durable O_EXCL local UNKNOWN before the sole SSH attempt; terminal O_EXCL receipt. Timeout, malformed remote output or partial chmod remains UNKNOWN or failed, with no automatic rollback or replay.
rollback_conditions: No automatic rollback. If group-write is later proven necessary, first stop future staging/graph writers; recheck the same dev/inode/UID/GID, current modes 0755, ACL, fixed lease/final and active collaborators; obtain a separately reviewed reverse packet for exactly the two directories. If a lease/final exists or identity changed, reconcile read-only before deciding whether rollback is safe.
residual_risks: Group AlexYang explicitly includes yue.chen and HanBingChen. No documented requirement for group write was found in the scoped G279 Markdown/reviews, but documentation absence and a point-in-time /proc scan do not prove they have no active or future writer.
Old out/tmp/staging remain 0775; correcting root/control only meets staging v4's narrow path gate, not graph output isolation or graph authorization.
A same-UID process can still race or replace names between distinct syscalls; fd/inode/readback reduce but do not eliminate this risk.
Changing directory mode is externally visible to collaborators. This candidate does not authorize doing so before independent peer review and owner decision.
